name: [☢️] Bunker Rush
desc:
The end of the world has come. You and a handful of humans are the last survivors on earth. Protect your bunker from the monsters who will try to finish off humanity

[How to Play]
💰 Generate money
⚔️ Purchase and upgrade weapons and defense
🥊 Fight off monsters and survive
💎 Earn gems to unlock more items

👍 This game is in BETA, show support for development to continue!
